QUOTE: ret & 0xFF80 ≠ 0 ? (high-level part) mbedtls_high_level_strerr(ret) → "ECP - ..." ... buf already has text? append " : " (only if ≥5 bytes remain) ... mbedtls_low_level_strerr(ret); "Result for `-0x4F82`: `ECP - <high-level text> : <low-level text>`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the code has a high-level module part and a low-level part, and that mbedtls_strerror renders both joined with " : " when both are present.
